clock_note: Scenario time is UTC (Portugal is on WET = UTC+0 in March).

injects.title: HD-4490: the delivery schedule will not open
injects.text: Carlos Mendes, shift supervisor at Carregado, opens HD-4490: he cannot open Plano_Entregas_S11.xlsx on \\FS01\Logistica. 'Excel diz que o ficheiro está corrompido.' Trucks start loading at 09:00.
injects.prompt: What do you do with this ticket, and who does it?

injects.title: Files renamed .crs3 on three shares
injects.text: João Pires calls Rui Calado: every folder he opened on Logistica, Finance and HR has files ending in .crs3 and a LEIA-ME_CRS3.txt. HD-4491 (Finance) and HD-4492 (HR) came in meanwhile. FS01 is still on the network and users keep trying to open files.
injects.prompt: Is this an incident? Who declares it, at what time? Who is incident manager, who is scribe?

injects.title: The ransom note
injects.text: João Pires pastes the content of LEIA-ME_CRS3.txt into the incident chat (evidence/ransom-note.txt). He also says: 'Shall I pull FS01's power cable? That stops it for sure.'
injects.prompt: Containment of FS01: what exactly do you do, who authorises it, what does it cost, and what do you preserve first?

injects.title: Logistics cannot dispatch
injects.text: Paulo Ramos (Logistics director): 'Trucks leave Carregado at 10:00 for 140 stores. Without the schedules we are blind. I need FS01 back by 09:30, or at least the schedules.'
injects.prompt: What business workaround do you authorise, and who owns it? What do you tell him about FS01?

injects.title: The DPO asks
injects.text: Ana Fonseca (DPO): 'The HR share has payroll, IBAN and NIF of every employee, and some medical certificates. Is this a personal data breach? When did our 72 hours start? Who decides whether we notify the CNPD?'
injects.prompt: Answer her three questions. Record the 'aware' time you are using and why.

injects.title: The backups are gone
injects.text: João Pires: 'SRV-BKP01: /srv/backup/fs01 and /srv/backup/dc01 are empty. The restic timer is disabled. The last thing we have is the monthly tape from 1 March, in the Carregado safe.'
injects.prompt: What do you do with SRV-BKP01, and with the tape? Who owns each?

injects.title: 'Let me wipe FS01 now'
injects.text: Sofia Teixeira: 'FS01 is dead anyway. Let me wipe it now and restore the 1 March tape, we would be back by tonight. Every hour we wait costs Logistics.'
injects.prompt: Do you authorise it? If not now, what has to happen first, and who decides when?

injects.title: The insurer
injects.text: The broker for Mútua Atlântica Seguros (fictional) calls back the CFO: the policy (CYB-2025-004417) requires written notice within 48 h and the use of the panel firm Faroleiro DFIR, Lda. (fictional). 'Do not talk to the attackers before you talk to us. Have you notified anyone yet?'
injects.prompt: Who notifies the insurer, when, and what do you send? What other clocks are running right now?

injects.title: The leak threat
injects.text: Someone in Finance opened the portal from the note. The chat says: 'We have 2.1 GB of your Finance and HR. Sample attached: Processamento_Salarios_2026-02.xlsx, IBAN_Fornecedores.xlsx. Pay EUR 450 000 in 5 days or everything goes on our blog.'
injects.prompt: What does this change for GDPR (arts. 33/34), for NIS2, and for your communications? Who opened the portal, from which machine, and should they have?

injects.title: The CFO wants to pay
injects.text: Luís Moreira (CFO): 'The insurance covers it. Let us pay today and get the decryptor: every day without deliveries costs more than that.'
injects.prompt: Who has the authority to decide on payment? What must be true before anyone could even consider it?

injects.title: A journalist calls
injects.text: A reporter from Diário do Norte (fictional) calls reception: supermarkets in Porto say Ceres deliveries did not arrive, and a post on a ransomware forum names Ceres. 'Can you confirm a cyberattack?'
injects.prompt: Who answers, and with what words? Write the holding statement (three sentences maximum).

injects.title: 'That was not me'
injects.text: João Pires: 'FS01's TerminalServices log shows RDP sessions as CERES\j.pires from 10.20.30.47 — that is Marta's PC, WS-FIN-07. I was not connected. And I am a Domain Admin.'
injects.prompt: What does this change: scope, containment, accounts, and who is on the response team?
